item.title: Fall 2026 US Anime Lineup: Crunchyroll Confirms Black Clover and Apothecary Diaries
item.description: Crunchyroll's Fall 2026 catalog includes Black Clover Season 2, The Apothecary Diaries Season 3 and more titles with North American availability.

item.title: MASHLE Season 3 Confirmed for Crunchyroll Streaming in January 2027
item.description: The Tri-Magicathlon Divine Visionary Final Exam Arc of MASHLE arrives in January 2027; Crunchyroll confirms US streaming rights.

item.title: Medaka Kuroiwa Season 2 Heads to Crunchyroll in January 2027
item.description: Crunchyroll confirms a January 2027 stream of Medaka Kuroiwa Season 2 in North America, plus a December 6 preview at Anime Frontier in Texas.

item.title: Rascal Does Not Dream of a Dear Friend Sets February 2027 US Screenings
item.description: Crunchyroll and Sony announce February 21, 23 and 24 US screenings for Rascal Does Not Dream of a Dear Friend, with subtitle and dub options.
